entities.name: Josué Brachi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Josué Brachi García is a Spanish male weightlifter, competing in the 56 kg category and representing Spain at international competitions. He participated at the 2016 Summer Olympics in the men's 56 kg event. He competed at world championships, including at the 2015 World Weightlifting Championships.
